Contract Scope & Assignment 1.1 The successful Bidder (“Supplier”) shall not sub-let, transfer, assign, or delegate the Contract or any p art thereof to any third party without the prior written consent of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospita l, Tirunelveli. 1.2 The Supplier shall be entirely responsible for the complete execution of the Purchase Order in all respe cts, including supply, transportation, installation, testing, commissioning, demonstration, training, strictly i n accordance with the terms and conditions of the tender and Purchase Order. 1.3 The Supplier shall ensure that all activities related to the supply and commissioning of the equipment are carried out by qualified and trained personnel. 2. Breach of Contract & Risk of Non-Performance 2.1 Failure of the Supplier to fulfil any terms, conditions, specifications, delivery obligations, warranty obli gations, or service commitments under the tender/Purchase Order shall be treated as a breach of contract.

2.2 In the event of breach, the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli shall have the right to ta ke appropriate action, including arranging alternative procurement/service arrangements at the risk and c ost of the Supplier. 2.3 Any additional expenditure incurred by the Purchaser due to such failure shall be recoverable from the Supplier. 3. Product Quality, Authenticity & Compliance 3.1 All equipment supplied shall be brand new, unused, of current production, and shall conform strictly to the technical specifications mentioned in the bid documents. 3.2 Refurbished, reconditioned, used, or obsolete equipment shall not be accepted. Any such equipment f ound during inspection or at any stage shall be rejected, and the Supplier shall bear all costs related to re moval, replacement, transportation, and re-supply. 3.3 The Supplier shall provide genuine OEM products, accessories, and components along with necessary certificates, manuals, and documentation. 4. Software, Firmware & Upgrades 4.1 Wherever applicable, the Supplier/OEM shall provide software updates, firmware upgrades, patches, a nd necessary technical support free of cost. 4.2 Any software required for the normal functioning of the equipment shall be supplied with valid licenses without additional cost. 5. Dispute Resolution & Jurisdiction 5.1 Any dispute arising out of this Purchase Order shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussion. 5.2 In case of failure to resolve the dispute, the matter shall be dealt with as per applicable Government/G eM rules. 5.3 The courts at Tirunelveli shall have jurisdiction over matters arising out of this Purchase Order. 6. Delivery Location and Timings 6.1 The delivery location shall be: Main Stores, ESIC Hospital, Salai Street, Vannarpettai, Tirunelveli – 627003 6.2 Delivery shall be made during the following timings: Monday to Friday: 09:30 AM to 03:00 PM Saturday: 09:30 AM to 12:00 Noon 6.3 The Supplier shall give prior intimation to the Stores Department before dispatch of the equipment. 7. Delivery Period & Liquidated Damages 7.1 The Supplier shall complete delivery, installation, commissioning, and acceptance of the equipment wi thin the stipulated delivery period mentioned in the Purchase Order. 7.2 In case of delay in delivery/installation/commissioning beyond the approved delivery period, the Purch aser shall have the right to impose Liquidated Damages as per applicable GeM/Government procurement r ules.

7.3 The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel the order in case of unreasonable delay. 8. Inspection, Installation & Acceptance 8.1 The equipment shall be subject to inspection and verification by the Purchaser or a committee authori zed by the Medical Superintendent. 8.2 The Supplier shall be responsible for safe transportation, unloading, installation, commissioning, and d emonstration of the equipment. 8.3 Final acceptance of the equipment shall be subject to satisfactory installation, commissioning, perform ance demonstration, and certification by the user department. 9. Training & Demonstration 9.1 The Supplier shall provide adequate training to the end users/operators at the installation site free of c ost. 9.2 The training shall include operation, preventive maintenance, safety precautions, troubleshooting, and other relevant aspects required for effective utilization of the equipment. 9.3 Training completion reports shall be submitted to the Purchaser. 10. Documentation The Supplier shall provide the following documents along with the equipment: User manual and service manual (where applicable) Warranty certificate Calibration certificates (where applicable) Installation and commissioning report Preventive maintenance schedule OEM authorization/support documents Any other documents required under the tender 11. Performance Security 11.1 The Supplier shall submit Performance Security as applicable under GeM/Government procurement r ules within the stipulated period. 11.2 Failure to submit Performance Security may result in action as per the terms and conditions of the Pu rchase Order. 12. Payment Terms 12.1 Payment shall be released through the GeM payment mechanism after successful delivery, installatio n, commissioning, acceptance of the equipment, and submission of required documents. 12.2 Payment shall be subject to satisfactory certification by the consignee/user department. 13. Force Majeure 13.1 The Supplier shall not be liable for forfeiture of Performance Security, Liquidated Damages, or termin ation for default if and to the extent that delay or failure to perform obligations is caused by a Force Majeu re event. 13.2 Force Majeure means an event beyond the reasonable control of the Supplier which could not have b

een foreseen or prevented despite due diligence. Such events may include war, riots, natural disasters, fire, floods, epidemics, quarantine restrictions, and freight embargoes. 13.3 The Supplier shall immediately notify the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Tirunelveli, in writin g, regarding the occurrence of such event and provide supporting details. 13.4 The Supplier shall continue to perform its obligations to the extent reasonably possible and shall tak e all necessary steps to minimize the impact of such event. 14. Confidentiality The Supplier shall maintain confidentiality of all information, documents, and data obtained during executi on of the contract and shall not disclose the same to any third party without prior approval of the Purchase r 15. Compliance with Applicable Laws The Supplier shall comply with all applicable Central Government, State Government, statutory, regulatory , safety, and medical equipment-related requirements during execution of the contract. .
